scope: Three source roots: AuthContainer complexity/immutable personalization, form hidden-field construction, script attribute construction. No generated-file edits, suppressions, dependency or unrelated changes.

rootCauses.name: AuthContainer mixed visibility and personalization
rootCauses.impact: Shared CMS headline/button templates were mutated on render. Subsequent users could retain previous personalization; frozen content throws. Regression reproduced the frozen-content failure. Complexity mixed role/display decisions with this mutation.
rootCauses.fix: Extract cohesive visibility and personalization functions. Personalize copies of headline/button blocks and preserve other blocks. Keep display/role rules, comma trimming, editor bypass, first-occurrence placeholder replacement and body/children precedence. These remain client-side display rules, not authorization enforcement.
rootCauses.tests: Nine tests cover changing users with frozen CMS templates and the existing anonymous/logged-in/role/editor visibility matrix. Original personalization regression failed before the change.

rootCauses.name: Hidden-field accumulator copying
rootCauses.impact: Repeatedly copies every accumulated field during submission. Small forms have negligible absolute cost; synthetic large lists show quadratic growth and measurable blocking work. Production input sizes/latency not established.
rootCauses.fix: Build once with Object.fromEntries, preserving literal special keys and last-entry precedence. Keep CMS fields before caller fields, numeric conversions, downstream falsy filtering and onSubmit semantics.
rootCauses.tests: Immutable input and exact old/new equivalence including duplicate keys, numeric/empty/invalid values, __proto__ and constructor. Large-list coverage plus actual component submission test validates payload and callback behavior.

rootCauses.name: Script attribute accumulator copying
rootCauses.impact: Every AppHead render repeatedly copied earlier attributes. Small lists cost little; large synthetic lists reveal quadratic growth. No measured production page slowdown claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Extract the parser and build one object with Object.fromEntries. Preserve existing comma/equal splitting, whitespace, duplicate precedence and undefined/empty results; do not silently change malformed-input parsing.
rootCauses.tests: Nine parser tests cover old/new equivalence for empty input, whitespace, duplicates, missing values, extra equals, special names and large lists.

recipeReview: Fetched canonical recipes with no-cache curl and reviewed validation/false-positive boundaries. Complexity fix separates meaningful visibility and personalization responsibilities, confirmed by runtime tests. Object.fromEntries follows the recipe's candidate correction; unlike naive property assignment it preserves own __proto__ keys. Benchmarked original algorithms against actual new helper implementations with equal outputs.
grouping: Three independent source roots; two repeated-copy sites have different data contracts and callers. No duplicate sites were counted as separate fixes within one root.

benchmark.method: Node performance.now, 3 warmups then 10 samples per actual old/new helper algorithm, median sample. Includes parsing/mapping and object construction. Synthetic input sizes, not live-site measurements. Module-loading time excluded.

validation.eslint: All nine changed source/test files pass without warnings/errors
validation.format: Prettier check and git diff --check pass
validation.overallCount: 128 to 106 across scans, but only three source removals belong to this pass. Nineteen generated-artifact diagnostics also disappeared outside this work; do not attribute them to these fixes.
validation.limitations: No production build, browser-performance trace or live auth/provider tests. Component tests mock rendering boundaries and role checks; performance measurements are synthetic.

followUp: Repeated membership checks require workload measurement before Set conversion.
Context-value identity, image sizing and initial-state warnings remain.
